title: Figure 1: Dipole electric field generator - wire-wound torus with E and B fields
description: Shaded line drawing of a torus wrapped with wire carrying current I, with dashed arrows labeled "B" circulating inside the torus and looping field lines labeled "E" around it, plus a central downward "E" arrow. The caption reads "Figure 1. Dipole Electric Field Generator (Reference 14)." Surrounding text gives Equation (4) for the electric field at the torus center and introduces Forward's dipole gravitational field generator.
